citations.title: GTM Engineer | Fundraise Up
excerpts: * Build enrichment waterfalls, lead scoring models, and CRM sync pipelines with deduplication logic in Clay. Own the quality and reliability of data flowing into our GTM systems from prospecting sources.
* Administer Gong, build Flows and coaching triggers, and surface deal risk signals directly in Salesforce. Help revenue leadership turn conversation data into actionable insights.

* Ship AI-powered automations, including outreach generation, call summaries, and ICP scoring, using LLM APIs integrated into Clay, Salesforce, and Nooks. Identify new opportunities to apply AI across the GTM motion.
* Own CRM data quality end-to-end, including validation rules, deduplication, enrichment refresh cycles, and maintaining a GTM data dictionary. Data health is a metric you're accountable to.
* Build event-driven automations across the GTM stack and own the integration layer between Salesforce, Clay, Gong, and other revenue tools. When systems don't talk to each other, you fix that.

basis.reasoning: The company subprocessor page names HubSpot, Salesforce, and Gong and describes their CRM/sales uses. The company’s GTM Engineer posting names Clay, Gong, Salesforce, and Nooks as systems used in its go-to-market stack.
